output.summary: Turnover rose firm-wide (E2, E3), and the rise cannot be attributed to any single cause on current evidence. Pay was the top exit reason in both years (E4), so it does not explain the change, and the only market benchmark is from 2023 (E5). Schedule-related complaints rose sharply (E4, E9). The HRIS migration artifact is ruled out because counts reconcile to payroll (E2). Manager blame rests on a stale manager field (E13) and interested-party claims (E12). Cedar Hollow's rise far exceeds peers' (E14). Overtime tracks vacancies by design (E15). Branch-level separations and a ShiftWise versus non-ShiftWise comparison are needed before committing to pay or manager actions. The manager bonus withholding is harmful. Evidence is insufficient.
